title: Telangana High Court directs Housing Board to execute flat sale deeds within 10 days

title: Telangana sends power restoration teams to cyclone-hit Andhra Pradesh

title: Arundathi Institute of Medical Sciences inaugurates fourth MBBS batch for 2026–27

title: Cyberabad civic body proposes road widening between Gajularamam and Mahadevapuram junction

title: Hyderabad: Public policy expert seeks groundwater-use caps for hotels amid water concerns

title: US Markets Today: US stocks end lower as Alphabet revenue miss revives AI capex jitters
description: Wall Street ended the day on a sour note, as Alphabet's revenue shortfall cast a shadow over the AI investment landscape and overall market stability. The Nasdaq Composite was hardest hit, plummeting by 1.36 percent. Although the economy shows robust growth, investor focus shifted to inflation numbers and corporate profitability, which displayed resilience.

title: Cash takes centre stage as investors rethink AI spending boom
description: Investors are increasingly focused on technology companies' cash generation capabilities to fund artificial intelligence investments. Microsoft and Oracle are gaining positive attention from investors, while Alphabet faces challenges due to rising AI costs. Alphabet's spending has surpassed its operating cash flow, raising concerns about its financial sustainability. In contrast, Microsoft's strong cash flow and forecasted growth indicate effective AI investment returns.

title: Alphabet’s AI risks deepen as filing reveals $98 billion in commitments beyond the $1 trillion spending
description: In a recent regulatory disclosure, Alphabet reveals financial risks linked to its massive AI investments that surpass $1 trillion. The firm might be burdened with nearly $98.5 billion in contingent commitments, including data center leases and chip system repurchases. There are growing apprehensions about the sustainability of Google Cloud's expansion due to a substantial backlog from its collaboration with Blackstone.
